text:
alex: Heads-up — starting the deploy for model-routing-v3 and flipping the routing feature flag (model-routing-v3-ff). Canaries in us-west first, change window ends in 3h. Release notes: https://go/release/2026-03-model-routing-v3 :eyes:

deploy-bot: kick-off accepted. Canary group id=cr-5123. Will route 1% traffic to v3 in us-west. Links: canary dashboard https://dash/redwood/canary/cr-5123, logs https://logs/redwood?q=cr-5123

maya: ack. I'll watch p50/p95 latency and 5xx. If p95 > baseline + 100ms or 5xx spike, call rollback.

ravi: v2 pin prepared: tag=v2-pin-2026-03-21, rollback playbook at https://internal/rollbacks/v2-pin. I also pre-warmed upstream pools.

sam: FF schedule I'm pushing now. Keep holdpoints at 5% and 25% for manual verify. Here's the rollout snippet I'm applying:```
feature_flag: model-routing-v3-ff
rollout:
  - t0: 1%
  - t+10m: 5%  # holdpoint
  - t+40m: 25% # holdpoint
  - t+3h: 100%
slo_triggers:
  error_rate: 0.5%  # immediate rollback
  p50_latency_increase: 30ms
  p95_latency_increase: 100ms
```

alex: Good. Keep the default fallback route pinned to v2 for any 503s. Notify @erica (oncall) once we hit 25%.

erica: oncall here. I'll open a quick watch channel and run the smoke synthetic job list. Ping me for immediate rollback.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics at t+12m: success. p50 +8ms, p95 +24ms, 5xx rate within noise. Advancing to 5%. Step action: set ff to 5% in us-west.

maya: seeing a small uptick in tail latency for one shard (us-west-2a) — digging. Not yet at trigger but watching.

ravi: noted. If that shard persists >15m, we should consider localized drain + pin that AZ to v2. I can push an AZ routing override.

sam: hold on 25% until maya gives :thumbsup:. Can we also enable KV cache warmup for v3 in us-west before big step?

alex: yes, do that. And reminder: do not increase beyond 25% until at least 30 minutes of stable metrics post-5%.

infra-bot: KV cache warmup triggered for model-routing-v3 in us-west, status=started.

deploy-bot: At t+45m -> metrics stable. p50 +10ms, p95 +30ms (within our trigger), 5xx nominal. Ready to move to 25% when eng-release leads confirm.

maya: :thumbsup: I'm green on latency/errs for 25m. Proceed to 25% and keep the 25% holdpoint for 30m.

sam: rolling to 25% now. Command used: `/ff roll model-routing-v3-ff --region us-west --target 25 --hold 30m`

deploy-bot: Flag updated to 25% in us-west. Monitor: https://dash/redwood/canary/cr-5123/metrics

alex: reminder: watch infra cost metric — if token throughput increases by >40% we pause. Also watch the regression eval set we ran against v3.

maya: saw a tiny blip on a downstream service at t+60m, traced to a retry loop. Mitigated by a transient config bump, errors resolved. No rollback needed.

ravi: rolling pin plan still ready. If rollback, command will be: `/ff set model-routing-v3-ff 0% && route-pin set default model-router v2 --tag v2-pin-2026-03-21` — I have permissions queued.

alex: consensus to complete the ramp to 100% after 30m stable at 25% and no service regressions. If anything crosses SLO triggers listed in the rollout snippet, immediate rollback and IR.

deploy-bot: At t+2h metrics are healthy. Proceeding with auto-step to 100% is disabled per holdpoints; manual approval required.

alex: I'll give manual approval in 10m if green. Keep the change window note: no new deploys to routing infra for next 2h.

erica: Verified synthetics and business KPIs (CTR +0.1%). Green from oncall. Send final confirmation when you hit 100%.

sam: approving final step. Pushing to 100% now. `/ff roll model-routing-v3-ff --region us-west --target 100`

deploy-bot: Flag at 100% in us-west. Global rollout scheduled next hour to eu and apac following same holdpoints. Canary cr-5123 closed (success). Release notes updated: https://go/release/2026-03-model-routing-v3#done

alex: nice work team. Postmortem triggers: none unless we see delayed regressions. I'll create release notes summary and a short runbook update for AZ-level drains.

maya: adding a small follow-up to monitor cache hit rates for 24h.

ravi: leaving v2-pin tag and rollback command in the runbook for 72h.

infra-bot: Reminder: maintainers please annotate the deployment in the calendar (change window closed).
